claims.claim: We also deal in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: General business claim, not shown or refuted by the photo.
No import documents, shipping labels, or country-of-origin markings visible on either engine.
No video or gauge/meter showing the engine running; photo is static and shows disconnected wiring harnesses.
Engine noise cannot be assessed from a still photo; would need audio/video of it running.
No odometer, hour-meter, or service sticker visible on either engine.
Valve cover/oil pan seals and bolt torque marks are not visible or close-up enough to confirm no prior disassembly.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal damage (knock, low compression, worn bearings)
risks.proof: Video of each engine starting and idling, plus a compression test reading

risks.risk: Engine completeness unknown (missing sensors, ECU, wiring loom, turbo, etc.)
risks.proof: Full 360° photos of each engine including intake, exhaust manifold side, and connector ends of harnesses

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, leaks, or corrosion not visible from this angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of oil pan, block, head gasket area, and underside

risks.risk: Unknown make/model/engine code, affecting compatibility and value
risks.proof: Clear photo of engine code/VIN plate or embossed casting number
risks.if_unproven: priced at generic used-engine floor until identified

risks.risk: Actual mileage/usage history cannot be confirmed
risks.proof: Photo of odometer from donor vehicle or service record/import paperwork

risks.risk: Origin claim (Belgium, Tokunbo) unverifiable, affecting trust in condition claims
risks.proof: Import documents, bill of lading, or customs clearance paperwork

proof_requests: Video of each engine starting, idling, and revving with audible sound
Clear photo of engine code/casting number or VIN plate on each engine
Close-up photos of oil pan, block, and head gasket area for leaks/cracks
Full set of photos showing all sides of each engine, including connector ends of wiring harnesses
Any import/customs documentation or compression/diagnostic test printout
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies two used car engines, so a worst-case price (untested, unverified origin and completeness) can be set now, pending proof to justify a higher price.
